shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/lib/auth.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json; cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/next/; cat node_modules/next/navigation.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/client/components/ | grep -i -E 'forbidden|unauthorized|not-found|http-access'

cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/forbidden.js; grep -n -i -A3 'authInterrupts\|forbidden' node_modules/next/AGENTS.md | head -60; grep -rn 'authInterrupts' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js 2>/dev/null | head; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && echo "--- /admin" && curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/admin && grep -o -E '403|Access Forbidden|restricted to administrators|Admin Dashboard' /tmp/admin.html | sort -u && echo "--- /" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && cat .gitignore && git status --short
